title: quarterlyfiscalcalendar
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, salespersonid, transactioncurrencyid.

createdon.description: Date and time when the quota for the quarterly fiscal calendar was created.

effectiveon.description: Date and time when the quarterly fiscal calendar sales quota takes effect.

exchangerate.description: Exchange rate for the currency associated with the quarterly fiscal calendar with respect to the base currency.

fiscalperiodtype.description: Type of fiscal period used in the sales quota.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the quarterly fiscal calendar was last modified.

quarter1.description: Sales quota for the first quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter1_base.description: Base currency equivalent of the sales quota for the first quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter2.description: Sales quota for the second quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter2_base.description: Base currency equivalent of the sales quota for the second quarter in the fiscal year

quarter3.description: Sales quota for the third quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter3_base.description: Base currency equivalent of the sales quota for the third quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter4.description: Sales quota for the fourth quarter in the fiscal year.

quarter4_base.description: Base currency equivalent of the sales quota for the fourth quarter in the fiscal year.

userfiscalcalendarid.description: Unique identifier of the quarterly fiscal calendar.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the quarterly fiscal calendar.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the quarterlyfiscalcalendar.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the quarterly fiscal calendar.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the quarterlyfiscalcalendar.

_salespersonid_value.description: Unique identifier of the associated salesperson.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Unique identifier of the currency associated with the quarterly fiscal calendar.
